highlights.label: Positioned price vs grey market NPR 499–999

bullets: Designed Nepal GTM using the IN-SPAN diplomatic framework
Aligned with Indian Embassy Commerce Wing & NICCI for B2G channels with Indian MNCs operating in Nepal
Mapped grassroots penetration across university tech clubs, Microsoft Learn Student Ambassadors, and Google Developer Groups
Designed a zero-CAC Scholar's Pack with the Indian Embassy to seed adoption among top student influencers
Identified CAN Info-Tech 2026 (350,000+ visitors) as primary acquisition event and Nepal Bharat Library (500-seat auditorium) as press launch venue
Positioned Waystars as Nepal's first officially compliant AI platform — framing it as a knowledge tool, not just a commercial product
Designed a word-of-mouth first GTM approach leveraging existing founder networks and targeted outreach to curate the right room
Focused on getting the right 10 people in the room who would each bring 10 more — building a high-trust, high-value community from the ground up
Secured three marquee institutional partners: HSBC (financial credibility), Innovation Hub UP (government ecosystem access), and AKTU Lucknow (academic network)
Managed complete event logistics across two editions — timelines, venue coordination, approvals, ticketing, and guest experience
Designed curated goodies, custom decor, and a dedicated landing page to maintain brand consistency and drive pre-event engagement
Built BaithakX's complete brand identity from scratch — logo, colour system, typography, and creative assets across social, venue, and print collaterals
Positioned as an exclusive, invite-only community to create perceived scarcity and drive demand through aspiration rather than mass outreach
Built complete brand identity from scratch — defining visual language, tone, and brand story across 100+ assets including standees, banners, event collaterals, and a product catalogue
Developed a B2G-led GTM strategy positioning Greenverse as a premium, luxury air purifier brand
Secured placements with government officials and institutional buyers in high-visibility spaces — building brand credibility top-down rather than relying on traditional B2C acquisition
Generated 100+ warm leads through targeted outreach and strategic institutional partnerships, converting several into multi-order sales
Designed a comprehensive investor pitch deck showcasing Greenverse's value proposition and growth potential, supporting fundraising conversations
Crafted the entire program narrative — from initial paperwork and curation to story writing, every detail handled in-house
Managed venue selection, props, stage design, and all aspects of the shooting environment to provide a visually compelling backdrop
Established a distinctive brand identity — produced 14 promotional creatives and 10 videos to build interest and excitement
The 8-day shoot featured 7 founders, each sharing their stories and insights, with our team leading the shoot and directing each session
Editing outsourced due to a last-minute budget cut — but production quality was maintained throughout
With a paid podcast model and efficient promotional strategy, the program generated a strong reception — confirming the program's potential for future iterations
